title: An open HQ tab rebuilds the whole gym list every minute and writes "Looked at all gyms" to the log each time
what: To count new gyms for Needs you, HQ asks for the full all-gyms list with every gym's counts, once a minute, also in a background tab. That list writes one "Looked at all gyms" line to the HQ log every time, so one tab left open writes about 1,440 such lines a day. The Log page shows 100 lines at a time, so the real actions and looks at one gym are buried under them, and the database redoes every gym's counts each minute.
expected: Needs you asks only for a small count of new gyms, writes nothing to the log, and the log holds only real looks and actions.
fix_line: Give Needs you its own small new-gyms count that does not write to the log

title: Each gym's counts read through records with no index for the last-activity time and staff joins
what: For every gym, the counts behind All gyms and Needs you find the latest desk change by reading all of that gym's records (there is no index on the change time), add up this and last month's takings by reading every payment the gym ever took, and join staff without the removed filter, which the only gym-and-staff index needs. The work grows with every gym and every year of history, and it runs each minute (see the Needs you poll).
expected: These counts use indexes, or a small stored summary, so the gym list stays quick as gyms and history grow.
how_often: every time All gyms or Needs you loads
fix_line: Add an index on each gym's record change time and payment day, and filter staff the way the index expects

title: Feedback stops at the newest 200 and Leads at the newest 300, with no way to see older ones
what: The Feedback page shows at most the 200 newest messages for the chosen filter, and Leads the 300 newest. Nothing on the page says the list was cut, and there is no Show older button, so an older unanswered message or an older lead cannot be reached from HQ once more arrive.
expected: The page says when it shows only the newest ones and has a Show older button, like the Log page.
how_often: once there are over 200 messages or 300 leads
fix_line: Add a Show older button to Feedback and Leads and say when the list is cut

title: The All gyms page waits for five separate reads one after another
what: Opening All gyms reads the gym list, then branches, then this month's AI use, then today's AI use, then AI limits, then feedback counts, each waiting for the one before. None needs the others, so on a slow phone line the page waits for the sum of all of them.
expected: The independent reads run at the same time, so the page waits only for the slowest one.
fix_line: Run the gym list reads together instead of one after another

items.reason: No lab score: HQ sits behind sign-in, so the PageSpeed run did not include it. Code-read: about 165 KB of plain files (no framework, no third-party scripts, two module scripts), the service worker stores no pages; the one slow spot found is the All gyms page waiting on its reads in turn.

HQ lists gyms, not members. The gym list is drawn whole in the browser (fine at today's size) but rebuilt on the server every minute; Feedback and Leads are cut at 200 and 300 with no older page; Log pages by 100; support-access records cap at 200 and say so.
HQ is a web page; it has no phone app start or workout screen.

HQ's reads use the audit, gym, shop order and visit indexes; the per-gym counts miss an index for last change time, payment day and the staff joins. The advisor's 23 foreign keys without an index are on tables HQ does not filter by those keys.
